info.title: Artifact Registry Service
info.description: Multi-tenant artifact storage service. Proxies file uploads/downloads through storage_service (which owns MinIO credentials). Auth: API token via Authorization or X-Tenant-Id Bearer header, validated against license introspection service. Trusted-network callers (RFC 1918) can skip the token. Optional ClamAV virus scanning on upload.

get.description:
Health check endpoint.

Checks:
- Database connectivity
- MinIO connectivity
- ClamAV connectivity (if enabled)

All checks run in parallel with 10s overall timeout.

Readiness probe for Kubernetes.

Returns 200 when the database is reachable, otherwise 503 so that
Kubernetes pulls the pod out of the Service endpoints while the DB is
unreachable. Only the database is gated here (MinIO/ClamAV are out of
scope for readiness).

post.description:
Upload an artifact file.

Files are proxied through storage_service which handles MinIO storage
and virus scanning. No presigned URLs are used.

Pass X-Visibility: user to make the artifact private to the uploading subject.
Default is 'tenant' (visible to all tenant members).

patch.summary: Set an artifact's publish status (draft | published)
patch.description:
Publish or unpublish an artifact.

Only callers in the artifact's OWN tenant can change it. The lookup is
own-tenant (``include_system`` left False), so an inherited system artifact
is a 404 for every other tenant — the same answer as a nonexistent id, so
existence is not leaked — and ``can_mutate`` re-checks the tenant as a
second fence. Publishing a SYSTEM-tenant artifact is what makes it readable
by every other tenant; unpublishing withdraws it on the next read.
Publishing requires an explicitly resolved tenant (403 via the fallback).

400.description: Invalid request — X-Tenant-Id is not a tenant UUID (code INVALID_TENANT_ID)

patch.summary: Set an artifact's document metadata (title, doc_type, phase, summary, card_id)
patch.description:
PARTIAL update of the document metadata on an existing artifact.

Only fields present in the JSON body are written; an explicit ``null``
clears a field; unknown fields are a 422. Same write fences as
``/publish-status``: own-tenant lookup (an inherited system artifact is a
404, as is a nonexistent id) plus ``can_mutate``.

400.description: Invalid request — X-Tenant-Id is not a tenant UUID (code INVALID_TENANT_ID)

get.summary: Render an artifact as an HTML or PDF document
get.description:
Render the artifact as a readable document: ``format=html`` (default) or
``format=pdf``.

Sources: ``document.json`` (``{title, sections:[{heading, body_md, sources}]}``),
markdown / plain text, or any other JSON report (rendered as a definition list /
table of its top-level keys). HTML is sanitised (no raw HTML, no script, no
remote resources) with a table of contents from the headings and section sources
as footnotes; PDF is WeasyPrint over that HTML. Other content types are 415.

Rendered output is cached as a derived object per (artifact id, version, format);
``X-Render-Cache: hit|miss`` says which. Same tenant + visibility scoping as the
get-artifact route: a missing or invisible id is 404.

415.description: Content type cannot be rendered as a document

400.description: Invalid request — X-Tenant-Id is not a tenant UUID (code INVALID_TENANT_ID)

get.description:
Get a manifest of artifacts for a specific scope.

⛔ BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: `artifacts` used to hold EVERY row in the scope, so a
project-scope manifest over a large project scanned and serialised the lot.
It is now one page, and a caller that reads `artifacts` without reading
`truncated` will silently see less than it used to.

⚠️ The default `limit` is the CAP (1000), NOT the 100 the list endpoints
use, and that asymmetry is deliberate. MEASURED 2026-09-08 against the
production database: one project holds 55,036 artifacts, and the live
`n8n-nodes-artifacts` `getManifest` sends neither `limit` nor `offset` and
discards response headers. A default of 100 would silently 550x-truncate a
live consumer; 1000 makes that 55x while the client is fixed to page. The
by-card route keeps the 100 default because it matches nothing today
(`card_id` is NULL on all 55,057 production rows).

A partial manifest is only safe because truncation is VISIBLE in the body:
`total_count` and `total_size` are computed by the DATABASE over the whole
scope (which is what their descriptions have always claimed), and
`truncated` states the comparison outright — `offset + len(artifacts) <
total_count` — so a client cannot miss it by failing to ask. Page by
raising `offset` until `truncated` is false.

400.description: Invalid request — X-Tenant-Id is not a tenant UUID (code INVALID_TENANT_ID)

post.summary: Submit a review decision for an artifact
post.description:
Record a human review decision against an artifact.

Inserts a row in `artifact_reviews` capturing decision + comment +
reviewer + timestamp, then updates the artifact's `status` to the
resulting state (approve→approved, reject→rejected, revise→needs_revision).

Tenant + visibility scoping mirrors the delete/get endpoints. The
artifact must be in the caller's tenant (or visible per X-Visibility=user
rules). Reviews are persisted under the reviewer's home tenant — recorded
on the review row — so cross-tenant reviews (super-admin) preserve audit
integrity.

The N8N webhook callback (when `artifacts.review_callback_url` is set on
the row) is fired by the BFF (fr-backend), not here — this endpoint stays
pure DB. Keeping the callback at the BFF avoids artifact_service
egressing to arbitrary URLs.

400.description: Invalid request — X-Tenant-Id is not a tenant UUID (code INVALID_TENANT_ID)

get.summary: List review history for an artifact
get.description:
Return one PAGE of an artifact's reviews, oldest-first.

⛔ BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: this returned EVERY review row for the artifact with
no limit — the same unbounded-read defect as the by-card and manifest
routes, on a table that grows once per review submission and is never
pruned. `limit`/`offset` match the list endpoints (default 100, max 1000)
and the bound is applied in SQL.

Truncation is reported in `X-Total-Count` (the full match count before
limit/offset), since the body is a bare array with nowhere to carry it:
truncated exactly when `offset + len(body) < X-Total-Count`.

The 100 default is safe here where the manifest's is not: MEASURED
2026-09-08 against the production database, `artifact_reviews` holds
ZERO rows, so no live caller can be truncated by it today.

X-Total-Count.description: Rows matching the query BEFORE limit/offset. The response is truncated when `offset + len(body) < X-Total-Count`.

400.description: Invalid request — X-Tenant-Id is not a tenant UUID (code INVALID_TENANT_ID)

get.summary: List artifacts across all projects in tenant
get.description:
List artifacts across ALL projects in the caller's tenant.

Tenant + visibility scoped via `visibility_scope()`; otherwise mirrors the
per-project `list_artifacts` filter surface. Used by the fr-backend Library
workspace tab and other callers that hold tenant context but no project_id.

get.summary: List artifacts by card across all projects
get.description:
List artifacts matching a card_id across ALL projects.

Returns one PAGE of the artifacts the caller can see (tenant + visibility
scoped) that have the given `card_id`, regardless of which project the
artifact belongs to. Required by n8n improvement-loop workflows that hold
tenant_id + card_id but not project_id.

Optional `name_prefix` filters by `Artifact.filename.startswith(name_prefix)`,
matching the per-project list endpoint's semantics.

`limit`/`offset` mirror `list_artifacts` and `list_artifacts_cross_project`
exactly (default 100, max 1000). ⛔ BEHAVIOUR CHANGE: this route used to
return EVERY matching row, so a long-lived card could make it scan and
serialise tens of thousands of artifacts. It now returns at most `limit`.
So that the truncation is never silent, the full match count for the query
(ignoring limit/offset) is returned in the `X-Total-Count` header: a caller
is truncated exactly when `offset + len(body) < X-Total-Count`, and pages
by raising `offset` until that is false.

schema.title: Response Artifacts List By Card Cross Project

X-Total-Count.description: Rows matching the query BEFORE limit/offset. The response is truncated when `offset + len(body) < X-Total-Count`.

400.description: Invalid request — X-Tenant-Id is not a tenant UUID (code INVALID_TENANT_ID)

get.summary: Get artifact metadata by id across all projects in tenant
get.description:
Get one artifact by id without knowing its owning project.

Tenant + visibility scoped exactly like `list_artifacts_cross_project`
(published system-tenant rows are inherited read-only). A missing artifact
and one the caller cannot see are indistinguishable: both are 404, never
403. Used by fr, whose asset bindings store only the artifact id.

400.description: Invalid request — X-Tenant-Id is not a tenant UUID (code INVALID_TENANT_ID)

ArtifactMetadataIn.title: ArtifactMetadataIn
ArtifactMetadataIn.description:
PATCH body for an artifact's document metadata.

PARTIAL update: only the fields PRESENT in the body are written. A field sent
as ``null`` clears it; a field left out is unchanged. ``card_id`` follows the
same rule.

status.description: Review status reflecting the latest review decision

publish_status.description: draft | published. A published SYSTEM-tenant artifact is readable by every tenant (is_system=true); drafts stay in the owning tenant.

is_system.title: Is System
is_system.description: True when this artifact is inherited from the system tenant (read-only for the caller). False for the caller's own artifacts, including the system tenant reading its own.

review_callback_url.title: Review Callback Url
review_callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL set by the producer (typically an n8n custom node). The fr BFF POSTs the review decision here when a human reviews the artifact. Never set by humans; ignored on user-facing uploads.

ArtifactStatus.title: ArtifactStatus
ArtifactStatus.description: Review status of an artifact. Reflects the latest review decision.

card_id.title: Card Id
card_id.description: Card this artifact is the output of. Supply it whenever the upload happens with a card in context — this is the deliverable link, and the only thing that makes /api/artifacts/by-card/{card_id} able to find the artifact later. Omit it ONLY for uploads with genuinely no card (human library uploads, system artefacts): those stay NULL on purpose, not by accident.

origin_kind.title: Origin Kind
origin_kind.description: Provenance: tenant (human library upload) | project | workflow

origin_workflow_run_id.title: Origin Workflow Run Id
origin_workflow_run_id.description: Required when origin_kind='workflow' (n8n run id, max 200 chars)

created_by_user_id.title: Created By User Id
created_by_user_id.description: Subject id of the creator. Defaults to the authenticated X-Subject-Id when omitted; empty string when the caller is tenant-only.

publish_status.description: draft (default) | published. Only meaningful for the system tenant: its PUBLISHED artifacts are inherited read-only by every other tenant.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Project phase that produced the document

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One-line summary shown in the document trail

planka_card_id.title: Planka Card Id
planka_card_id.description: Planka card id (any format, max 64). Defaults to the value of a `planka_card:<id>` tag when omitted.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the error was emitted

details.title: Details
details.description: Optional debug detail; only populated when LEAK_EXCEPTION_DETAILS=true

scope.description: Scope type: project, card, or step

scope_ref.title: Scope Ref
scope_ref.description: Scope reference: card UUID for 'card' scope, step identifier for 'step' scope, null for 'project' scope

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description: ONE PAGE of the artifacts in this scope (see `limit`/`offset`)

total_count.title: Total Count
total_count.description: Total number of artifacts in this scope

total_size.title: Total Size
total_size.description: Total size of all artifacts in bytes

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when `artifacts` does NOT cover the whole scope, i.e. `offset + len(artifacts) < total_count`. Raise `offset` (or `limit`) until this is false to read the scope in full. ⛔ A client that ignores this field is reading a partial manifest as if it were complete — which is why the flag exists as well as `total_count`: a number a caller never asked for is easy to miss, a boolean named `truncated` is not.

Manifest.title: Manifest
Manifest.description:
Manifest of artifacts for a specific scope.

Groups all artifacts within a project, card, or step scope
with aggregate statistics.

PublishStatus.title: PublishStatus
PublishStatus.description:
Publication state. A PUBLISHED system-tenant artifact is inherited read-only
by every other tenant; a DRAFT one never leaves the system tenant. Separate
axis from ArtifactStatus (the review decision).

ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision
ReviewDecision.description: The verb a reviewer submits. Maps to ArtifactStatus via DECISION_TO_STATUS.

decision.description: Review verb: approve, reject, or revise

ReviewIn.title: ReviewIn
ReviewIn.description: Input model for submitting a review decision against an artifact.

ReviewOut.title: ReviewOut
ReviewOut.description: Output model for a single review record.

ReviewResponse.title: ReviewResponse
ReviewResponse.description: Response after a review is submitted: updated artifact + the new review row.

artifact_id.title: Artifact Id
artifact_id.description: Unique identifier for the created artifact

storage_key.title: Storage Key
storage_key.description: Storage key where the file is stored

size.title: Size
size.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: SHA256 checksum of the uploaded file

card_id.title: Card Id
card_id.description: Card this artifact is the output of, as persisted (null = none supplied)

origin_workflow_run_id.title: Origin Workflow Run Id
origin_workflow_run_id.description: Origin n8n run id, as persisted

UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse
UploadResponse.description:
Response model for successful artifact upload.

Returned after file is uploaded through storage_service and
artifact record is created in the database.

BearerAuth.description: API token. Transport: `X-Tenant-Id: Bearer <token>` (not the Authorization header — that is reserved for caller-side auth).

TenantIdHeader.name: X-Tenant-Id
TenantIdHeader.description: Tenant UUID. A non-uuid value is rejected with 400 INVALID_TENANT_ID; omitting the header is rejected with 401 TENANT_REQUIRED (AUTH_TENANT_FALLBACK_MODE=enforce, the default).
